# First, check if mypy is available
if ! command -v mypy &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: mypy is not installed or not in PATH. Please install it to enable type checking."
    exit 1
fi
# Run mypy on the widgetkit package with strict mode
mypy --strict src/widgetkit
exit_code=$?
if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "mypy found errors. Please fix them before committing."
    exit $exit_code
fi
